done_when: The customer is verified and logged, and every fact the decision needs has been collected. One savings account + credit card pair has been recommended, with its APY breakdown and how each required feature is met: plus one new checking account when the customer wants one, or a checking + savings combination when the customer declines a card. The customer has agreed, chosen between cards that tie, or been told no option fits and why. Any requested openings or closures continue in opening_personal_savings_accounts, opening_personal_checking_accounts and closing_personal_checking_accounts. If a lookup tool failed with a system error, the customer was offered a transfer.

steps.do: For each remaining savings + card pair, compute the net yearly return: deposit × (sum of APY parts) minus fees. APY parts: the base or tier APY at that balance (Silver 4.0% at $10,000 or more, otherwise 2.5%; Silver Plus 4.5% at $15,000 or more, otherwise 3.0%); the highest card APY bonus on that account, from the account's own bonus table, among the candidate card and any card in cards_get; the linked-checking boost if the pair is listed; the Silver Plus 0.25% direct-deposit bonus only if the customer will set up direct deposit; and the 0.025% relationship bonus only where a document ties it to the pair (a Silver Account with a Platinum Rewards Card). Fees: 12 × the monthly maintenance fee if the balance is below the minimum, 12 × the paper-statement fee if paper is needed, and the card's annual fee. On a Gold Account, count the Gold Rewards Card's 0.025% once. Any other 0.025% relationship bonus has no stated criteria: mention it only as possible.

rules.rule: Worked comparison for this profile: deposit about $100,000 untouched; wants a new checking account; open to a card; age 27–61; no Rho-Bank+. Platinum Plus 7.0% + Purple +0.3% + Platinum Rewards +0.4% = 7.7%, which is $7,700 − $200 = $7,500. It beats the Crypto-Cash Back version ($7,475) and Platinum + Blue + Platinum Rewards ($7,350). Always recompute.

rules.rule: Worked comparison for this profile: deposit $10,000–$25,000 untouched; net of card fees; keeps only current checking (not paired); no Rho-Bank+; no invitation; card spend below $7,500 a month; electronic statements fine. Silver Account 4.0% + EcoCard 2.2% = 6.2% minus $50, beating Gold + EcoCard (6.1% − $50) and Gold + Silver Rewards (5.7%). Below $25,000, Gold Plus carries $15.00 × 12 = $180 and loses. At exactly $25,000, Gold Plus Account 6.0% + Crypto-Cash Back +0.3% = $1,575 − $75 = $1,500, a tie with Silver + EcoCard ($1,550 − $50): tell the customer, unless they refuse crypto rewards or score below 660. Always recompute.

rules.rule: Worked result for this profile, ranked net of fees: deposit $25,000–$49,999 kept all year; Rho-Bank+ active; no crypto; card fee ceiling below $200; checking not in the boost list. Gold Plus Account + Gold Rewards Card = 6.0% + 0.35% = 6.35%, with a $0 card fee and no maintenance fee. Platinum Account 6.5% + Gold Rewards +0.15% = 6.65% has the higher APY, but below Platinum's $50,000 minimum it carries $25.00 × 12 = $300 and nets less across the range (at $49,999: about $3,025 against $3,175). If the customer ranks by APY alone, show both. Always recompute.
